scenes.title: The Ordinary World
scenes.source_chunk: Wei Chen was an ordinary farmer...

panels.action_description: Wei Chen tends his rice paddies alone at dawn
panels.visual_prompt: manhua style, Chinese comic art, clean ink lines, vibrant flat colours, chinese farming village rice paddies morning mist, young Chinese farmer short black hair earth-toned robes, tends rice paddies alone, peaceful, wide shot

dialogue.speaker: narration
dialogue.text: Every morning, the same fields. Every evening, the same house.

panels.action_description: Wei Chen pauses and looks toward the mountain, longing
panels.visual_prompt: manhua style, Chinese comic art, clean ink lines, vibrant flat colours, chinese farming village mountain backdrop, young Chinese farmer short black hair, gazes at distant mountain, wistful longing, medium shot

scenes.title: The Discovery
scenes.source_chunk: One autumn day, while clearing brush...

panels.action_description: Wei Chen discovers the glowing jade egg in the cave
panels.visual_prompt: manhua style, Chinese comic art, clean ink lines, vibrant flat colours, ancient mountain cave jade-green glow moss-covered stone, young Chinese farmer, discovers glowing jade egg, mysterious awe, close-up

panels.action_description: Grandma Liu warns Wei Chen to leave the egg
panels.visual_prompt: manhua style, Chinese comic art, clean ink lines, vibrant flat colours, chinese farming village, elderly Chinese woman white hair bun embroidered jacket wooden cane and young farmer, elder warns young man, tense concern, over-the-shoulder

dialogue.speaker: Grandma Liu
dialogue.text: Leave it, child. Dragon eggs bring fortune or ruin — nothing between.

panels.action_description: The egg hatches — Yinzhu emerges and meets Wei Chen
panels.visual_prompt: manhua style, Chinese comic art, clean ink lines, vibrant flat colours, small chinese farmhouse hearth glow, young farmer and small silver dragon shimmering scales gold eyes, dragon hatches and looks at farmer, wonder and recognition, low angle

dialogue.speaker: narration
dialogue.text: Three days. Then the world cracked open.

panels.action_description: Wei Chen and Yinzhu look at each other — a bond is forged
panels.visual_prompt: manhua style, Chinese comic art, clean ink lines, vibrant flat colours, small chinese farmhouse warm firelight, young Chinese farmer holding small silver dragon, bonding moment, warm glow, close-up

dialogue.speaker: narration
dialogue.text: From that day, the fate of Qinghe was forever changed.
